examined_formations.title: PUBLIC_FLEET_TELEMATICS_AND_COMPLIANCE_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 公共车队车联网与合规自动化
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: Connecticut DAS announced a July 2026 renewal of its Geotab fleet-management partnership covering more than 3,600 state vehicles across over 90 agencies.

The renewed agreement adds custom automation for personal/business mileage, overnight-parking verification, fuel and maintenance integration, and compliance reporting, showing repeat buyer spend plus paid extension of the deployed control surface.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Vehicle telemetry, mileage, parking, fuel, maintenance and compliance events continuously regenerate fleet-oversight state.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: Geotab already provides the connected fleet platform, rules, alerts, reporting, maintenance, route and integration surfaces; its open SDK/marketplace and partner model explicitly support customer-specific automation.

examined_formations.title: PROBATION_ELECTRONIC_LOCATION_MONITORING
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: Lake County, Illinois approved an August 2026 contract with SCRAM Systems for adult-probation electronic monitoring at an estimated $400,000 per year.
The contract runs for two years with three one-year renewal options, establishing multi-year buyer-side recurring spend.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Court-ordered movement restrictions continuously regenerate location, zone, violation and supervision events that must be monitored and escalated.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: SCRAM already sells integrated GPS/location monitoring designed to surface movement trends, enforce restrictions, reduce manual review and support supervision responses.

examined_formations.title: SATELLITE_WATER_LEAK_DETECTION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 卫星遥感供水管网漏损检测
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: Philadelphia Water Department issued a 2026 purchase for a one-year ASTERRA SaaS satellite-radar leak-detection service.

The procurement specifies two full image scans, algorithmic analysis against the utility GIS layer, prioritized leak points, a dashboard and field-use applications, making the recurring machine-delivered unit explicit.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Underground network leakage continuously regenerates hidden loss locations that utilities want prioritized before field crews investigate and repair.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: ASTERRA Recover already provides satellite-based citywide leak detection, algorithmic analysis, prioritized likely leak locations and subscription delivery specifically to direct ground crews.

examined_formations.title: EMERGENCY_MASS_NOTIFICATION
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: Missoula County approved a 2026 five-year Everbridge master-services agreement for a workplace emergency mass-notification application at $43,143.42 annually plus a $6,487.04 setup fee.
Separate current municipal procurements also show multi-year public-warning contracts, confirming recurring institutional spend rather than a one-off experiment.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Emergencies, closures and safety incidents create time-critical recipient, location, channel and acknowledgement states that must be broadcast at scale.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: Everbridge already provides unified multi-channel, location-aware public warning across SMS, cell broadcast, voice, email, social and legacy channels at population scale.

examined_formations.title: SOLID_WASTE_ROUTE_OPTIMIZATION_AND_SERVICE_PLANNING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 环卫收运路线优化与服务规划
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: Toronto approved a June 2026 non-competitive agreement for continued RouteSmart use worth up to CAD 850,000 over five years while moving from an on-premises product whose support ended to the vendor's cloud platform.
The city also states that it is preparing a separate competitive long-term technology procurement, so the spend includes migration continuity rather than only routine license renewal.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Service locations, vehicle constraints, staffing, traffic and collection requirements repeatedly regenerate municipal route plans and daily execution changes.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: RouteSmart currently provides purpose-built waste route optimization, territory balancing, daily sequencing, cloud operations, mobile execution and APIs for dynamic route integration.

examined_formations.title: PUBLIC_SAFETY_COMPUTER_AIDED_DISPATCH
examined_formations.chinese_title: 公共安全计算机辅助调度
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: Monterey County approved the ninth annual 2026 renewal of its TriTech/CentralSquare computer-aided-dispatch maintenance agreement for up to $415,243.
The renewal raises the agreement total to $3,179,016 and authorizes up to three additional annual renewals, proving durable buyer-side repeat spend.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Emergency calls continuously regenerate location, incident, unit availability, prioritization and cross-agency dispatch state.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: CentralSquare currently connects 911, CAD, RMS, mobile and jail workflows with real-time mapping, unit recommendations, coordinated dispatch and growing native AI/integration features.
